name: cli_command
label: CLI command
description: A stego command a person or an agent types. It exposes one command or one query of its domain, as an endpoint does over HTTP.

name: cli_handler
label: CLI handler
description: The code of a file that parses one or more stego commands a person or an agent types, and runs the CLI commands and CLI queries it parses (runs). One handler per file.

name: cli_query
label: CLI query
description: A stego command a person or an agent types that asks one query: it sits under the query it asks, and its ID is the query's with -CLI.

name: generator
label: Generator
description: A file of a component generator: Go source or a template that emits part of the component's code, and so implements its output contracts.

name: library_contract
label: Library contract
description: A promise a runtime package makes to every service that imports it, stated with MUST; a service owner relies on it without reading the code.

name: library_contract_test
label: Library contract test
description: A test that proves one library contract.

name: library_file
label: Library file
description: A file of a runtime package and what in it keeps which contracts.

name: output_contract
label: Output contract
description: One fact that must always hold of the code a component emits, in whatever service it is emitted into. The component owns it, not the service.

name: output_contract_test
label: Output contract test
description: A test that proves exactly its parent output contract. Its file names its ID at the start of the test's name.

name: registry_component
label: Registry component
description: A component of the registry: a deterministic generator with its config schema, ports, slots and output contracts. It is versioned, staged and released as one unit.

name: retirement
label: Retirement
description: A deliberate removal of an obligation from the specification, written by the Product owner in the change that removes, renames or merges it: the obligation retired, why, and the record that carries its standing from then on, if any. The change gate's ratchet follows the successor instead of refusing the removal.

name: runtime_package
label: Runtime package
description: One package of the runtime library: code that is the same for every service, which generated code imports at the version its archetype pins instead of a generator emitting it.
